Oiled rawhide is a distinct material state from vegetable-tanned leather with a flexibility treatment. Rawhide is untanned hide that is dried and stiff, and oiling it imparts moisture resistance and some flexibility, but it remains susceptible to water damage and can revert to a hard state when wet. Vegetable tanning with a flexibility treatment (e.g., oils, fats, or mechanical softening) produces a tanned leather that is more permanently pliable and has improved water resistance compared to rawhide, though it is not fully waterproof and can be affected by prolonged or repeated wetting. The supported conditional effects are: oiled rawhide offers temporary moisture resistance and flexibility that diminishes with water exposure, while vegetable-tanned leather with flexibility treatment offers more durable flexibility and moderate water resistance, but both require care to avoid water damage.

Dye can be applied at various textile stages, such as fiber, yarn, fabric, or finished garment. A mordant can help fix the dye to the fiber, improving colorfastness and enabling certain dyes to bond with the textile. However, immersion dyeing and the use of a mordant are not necessary for every dye; some dyes do not require mordants, and application methods other than immersion (e.g., printing, spraying) exist.

Снятую шкуру обрабатывают для консервации и подготовки к выделке. Быстрое охлаждение и тщательная очистка меховой шкуры замедляют бактериальный рост и предотвращают повреждение корней волоса, что способствует удержанию волоса.

Vegetable tanning of an already prepared hide involves treating it with plant-derived tannins to chemically stabilize the collagen fibers, converting the hide into leather. This process imparts resistance to putrefaction by binding to and cross-linking the protein structure, making it less susceptible to microbial attack. Merely drying a hide removes moisture, which temporarily prevents decay but does not chemically alter the hide; once re-wetted, it remains prone to putrefaction. Plant tannins play the role of a chemical preservative and stabilizer, providing durable resistance to decomposition that drying alone cannot achieve.

§93 of the Extended Russkaya Pravda provides that if a small child is unable to care for himself and his mother remarries, the stepfather (or the child's relatives) must take the child with them, and the child's own property is to be given to him in the presence of witnesses. §96 provides that if a mother dies without having made a disposition (i.e., without a will or instruction), her portion goes to the child with whom she lived, or if all children are living with her, to all of them equally. These textual descriptions are general legal rules of the Russkaya Pravda and do not by themselves establish that any specific current person in Novgorod in 1230 had a particular duty; they describe conditional arrangements under that law but do not identify any individual or actual obligation in that time and place.

Goats are ruminants with a four-chambered stomach (rumen, reticulum, omasum, abomasum) that enables microbial fermentation of fibrous plant material like hay and grass. They have a specialized digestive system adapted to break down cellulose via symbiotic microbes, and they require a balanced diet including fiber, protein, minerals, and water. However, these general biological facts do not establish that a particular feed in front of a goat is safe and sufficient, because safety and sufficiency depend on specific factors such as the feed's composition, quality, contamination, the goat's age, health, and nutritional needs, which are not determined by general ruminant biology alone.

Биологически свиньи (моногастричные) переваривают волокно преимущественно в толстом кишечнике за счёт микробной ферментации, тогда как жвачные (например, коровы) ферментируют волокно в рубце до тонкого кишечника, что даёт им больше энергии из клетчатки. У свиней пищеварение в основном желудочно-кишечное с ограниченной микробной ферментацией, поэтому они хуже используют грубое волокно и требуют более концентрированных рационов. Энергетическая ценность корма для свиней ниже при высоком содержании волокна, а для жвачных — выше за счёт летучих жирных кислот из рубца. Однако эти общие различия не задают точный рацион конкретной свиньи, так как индивидуальные потребности зависят от возраста, веса, физиологического состояния, здоровья и состава корма.

runs.answer_text: Oiled rawhide is described as more resistant to moisture and water, but this is not impermeability or a result for every oil, skin, application, or water exposure. At the end of vegetable tanning, fats or oils may be worked into hard leather for flexibility; this is a conditional processing pathway, not a guaranteed result for all leather. Vegetable-tanned leather directly exposed to water may shrink or stiffen, and tannin migration may cause staining and surface embrittlement. Rawhide that becomes sufficiently wet can swell and shrinks as it dries. These are distinct material states: oiled rawhide has conditional moisture resistance, while vegetable-tanned leather has conditional flexibility treatment but is susceptible to water-induced shrinkage, stiffening, and tannin migration. The supplied facts do not establish present materials, historical availability, or exact outcomes.
